firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently found a gold treasure takes the key card and starts. If nobody has, the rules jokingly say everyone loses immediately, then offer the youngest player as an alternative starter.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The rulebook also says the game ends with everyone losing if nobody has found a gold treasure.
The key-card holder first opens another player's chamber. The owner of that chamber then receives the key.
